description:
Investigate spatially-coupled LDPC codes which achieve threshold saturation - their BP threshold approaches the MAP threshold of the underlying ensemble. Implement sliding window decoding for practical implementation. Research question: What are the gains over standard QC-LDPC for DVB-T2 block lengths?

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Delivers “Research spatially-coupled LDPC codes with sliding window decoding” with the behavior, scope, evidence, and constraints described above.
title: Research spatially-coupled LDPC codes with sliding window decoding
